ops.title: Claude credentials: Keychain first, file second, fall through on rejection
ops.body: Claude Code 2.1.293 reads OAuth credentials via M(keychain, plaintext): the Keychain item first, ~/.claude/.credentials.json only on a Keychain miss. spawnllm hosts read the file first until #14 (v0.17.1), so a stale file token (expired 2026-09-30 on yasyf's Mac) shadowed the live Keychain login and isolated claude -p runs failed with 'Failed to authenticate: OAuth token revoked' (145/200 capt-hook haiku calls). Since #14 every host seeds from the ordered [keychain, file] list, and a run the claude_auth_rejected core op classifies as an auth rejection records its token and reruns on the next source without spending max_attempts. Never delete or rewrite the user's .credentials.json to work around this.
